tool_input.command:
sed -n '1,260p' src/session.js && printf '
--- package ---
' && sed -n '1,200p' package.json && printf '
--- readme ---
' && sed -n '1,240p' README.md

/runtime/node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { Session } from './src/session.js'
const timers={schedule(fn){queueMicrotask(fn)}}
let calls=0
const offline=new Session({timers,queryFn({signal}){calls++; assert.equal(signal.aborted,false); return 'wrong'}},{online:false})
const h=offline.subscribe('new',{networkMode:'online'})
assert.deepEqual(offline.snapshot('new'),{status:'pending',fetchStatus:'paused',data:null})
offline.unsubscribe(h)
offline.online(true)
await Promise.resolve(); await Promise.resolve()
assert.equal(calls,0)
assert.deepEqual(offline.snapshot('new'),{status:'pending',fetchStatus:'idle',data:null})
let resolve
const background=new Session({timers,queryFn(){return new Promise(r=>resolve=r)}})
const b=background.subscribe('cache')
background.unsubscribe(b)
resolve('stop')
await Promise.resolve(); await Promise.resolve()
assert.deepEqual(background.snapshot('cache'),{status:'success',fetchStatus:'idle',data:'stop'})
let lateResolve, observedSignal
const consumed=new Session({timers,queryFn({signal}){observedSignal=signal; return new Promise(r=>lateResolve=r)}})
const c=consumed.subscribe('consumed')
consumed.unsubscribe(c)
assert.equal(observedSignal.aborted,true)
assert.deepEqual(consumed.snapshot('consumed'),{status:'pending',fetchStatus:'idle',data:null})
lateResolve('late')
await Promise.resolve(); await Promise.resolve()
assert.deepEqual(consumed.snapshot('consumed'),{status:'pending',fetchStatus:'idle',data:null})
console.log('session checks passed')
NODE
git diff --check && git diff -- src/session.js
rg -n "consumed|started|unsubscribe|invoke" src/session.js && /runtime/node --check src/session.js && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p\n' | sort
